diagnosis: deploy-bot scaled deployment/product-catalog from 1 to 0 replicas at 19:29:54, about 2 s before the alert. With no product-catalog pods and no endpoints, the frontend's products call gets an empty body, which surfaces as JSONDecodeError. Journeys have been failing since then (about 70% OK in the window, all failures on the products step). Restoring replicas to 1 returns the service to its pre-change state. The scale-down was not a rollback and may have been unintended, so the change source should be reviewed after recovery.
